sample_unit: real-world cancer pain electronic medical records

links.outcome: Comparison of LLMs with three RAG strategies on semantic consistency and evidence-based reasoning
links.effect: Claude-4 combined with RAG achieved the best overall performance, with outstanding semantic consistency and evidence-based reasoning across multiple metrics; decision accuracy of 0.841 for analgesic recommendation.
links.quote: Ultimately, Claude-4 combined with RAG achieved the best overall performance, demonstrating outstanding semantic consistency and evidence-based reasoning in multiple metrics.

unlisted_practices: Multi-agent LLM decomposition with a dedicated Safety-Check agent for cancer pain assessment and analgesic planning

screen.reason: Evaluates a multi-agent LLM framework (OncoPainBot) with RAG strategies and safety-checking agents on retrospective real-world EHR records for cancer pain management.

primary.practice: retrieval-augmented generation and multi-agent safety check
